vectors.description: PUBLISH_OK (REQUEST_OK, Type 0x07) with no parameters and empty Track Properties

non-canonical PUBLISH_OK — the EXPIRES parameter type (0x08, the first parameter, so the delta is the absolute type) is encoded as a 2-byte varint (8008) instead of the canonical 1-byte form (08); decoders MUST accept

PUBLISH_OK carrying SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY (0x20). Section 9.3 lists EXPIRES as the one parameter for PUBLISH_OK. Section 9.19.1: "If a parameter appears in some other type of message, the receiving endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
